claim_text: Fatigue is a nonspecific symptom and does not by itself establish iron deficiency or iron-deficiency anemia; diagnosis requires appropriate clinical assessment and, where indicated, laboratory testing.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, evidence-based nutrient assessment and avoid unsupported or unnecessary supplementation.

population.other_context: Adults reporting fatigue without established iron deficiency.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Iron Health Professional Fact Sheet describes iron deficiency and reference information; fatigue has many possible causes.
limitations: No iron dose or diagnosis from symptom alone.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
